mapper.select: SELECT p.id, s.name AS shop_name, p.title, p.summary FROM products p JOIN shops s ON s.id = p.shop_id WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND ( #{categorySlug} IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM product_categories pc WHERE pc.product_id = p.id AND pc.category_slug = #{categorySlug} ) ) AND ( p.title LIKE #{searchPattern} ESCAPE '!' OR p.summary LIKE #{searchPattern} ESCAPE '!' OR s.name LIKE #{searchPattern} ESCAPE '!' ) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT 24
SELECT p.id, s.name AS shop_name, p.title, p.summary FROM products p JOIN shops s ON s.id = p.shop_id WHERE p.id = #{productId} AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT id, name, price_cents, currency FROM packages WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND sale_status = 'ON_SALE' ORDER BY display_order, id
